title: Thanksgiving Buffet at The Buffalo Bar
seo_title: Thanksgiving Buffet at The Buffalo Bar in Ridgedale
description: This is a Thanksgiving buffet at the Buffalo Bar, where you can share a meal of holiday favorites and chef-inspired creations, with handcrafted cocktails and views on offer. It is set up for gathering with family and friends, and Top of the Rock entry is required, with a fee that may apply. It runs Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM at 190 Top of the Rock Rd in Ridgedale.
address: 190 Top of the Rock Rd, Ridgedale, 65739
